title: Rear visibility and hard-to-see controls
summary: This topic loosely groups comments about limited rearward visibility, obscured views through shades or screens, and a few unrelated mentions of hard-to-see features, with most examples not clearly expressing a sentiment.

positive.summary: One positive review describes a mirror visibility issue as an observed condition, but the sample is too small to identify a broader positive theme.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mainly mention blocked rear visibility from shades or blinds, requests for camera-based rear views, and a few unrelated hard-to-see items such as seat buttons or a lane-warning indicator.

limitations: Most reviews in this topic are undetermined, so clear sentiment conclusions are limited.

Only one positive example is available, which is insufficient to characterize a consistent positive pattern.
